limits: This is not full Google Sheets or Excel feature parity; charts, pivot tables, macros, cloud collaboration and the full formula catalog are not implemented
Filter criteria are session view state; XLSX saves the filter range and hidden rows, not the value-checkbox criteria
Names are workbook-scoped direct ranges; formula-defined and sheet-scoped names are not supported
XLSX is the format for these new workbook features; CSV is values-only and ODS does not preserve all of this metadata
Rich text, workbook-specific theme palettes, embedded workbook images and structured table references retain the existing limitations
